text:
andrew: Quick heads-up — planning to publish v2.8.0 tomorrow 18:00 PT. Need someone to own the publish flow (annotated tag, GH draft, upload artifacts, sign + checksums). Putting a tiny checklist below. Who can take this? :calendar: 

jamal: I can take the tag + signing if no one else has it. quick q: which branch should I tag from? main or release/2.8?

sophia: changelog still has one last PR (#1234) waiting on a small wording tweak. I'll merge it by EOD if reviewers approve. can we hold publish until it's in?

carol: I can handle uploading the linux/amd64 + macos/arm tarballs to the GH release and update the checksum manifest. also happy to run the upload script.

andrew: checklist (suggested):
```
- confirm final changelog merged (sophia)
- create annotated tag v2.8.0 from release/2.8 branch (jamal)
- sign tag with release GPG key and push signed tag (jamal)
- draft GitHub release, paste changelog, set prerelease flag if needed (jamal)
- upload build artifacts and checksums (carol)
- verify checksum signatures and update release assets (carol)
- add release notes + any special rollback instructions (andrew)
- trigger release-bot to notify channels and update docs (release-bot)
```

andrew: recommended commands for tagging/signing:
```bash
git checkout release/2.8
git pull origin release/2.8
git tag -a v2.8.0 -m "v2.8.0 — release notes here"
# sign the tag locally
git tag -s v2.8.0 -m "v2.8.0 signed"
git push origin v2.8.0
```

jamal: ok i'll tag from release/2.8 then. i have access to the release GPG key on my laptop, will use that. planning to do tag + draft at 17:30 PT so assets can be uploaded before 18:00.

carol: upload script I usually run: 
```bash
./scripts/build_release.sh --targets linux/amd64 macos/arm && 
./scripts/upload_release_assets.sh v2.8.0 --bucket releases.redwood.ai
```
will also regenerate checksums with `sha256sum` and upload `checksums.txt`.

release-bot: automated note — create-draft-release workflow is available: `.github/workflows/release-draft.yml`. If you add the `release:ready` label to the release PR, the action will draft the GH release for you.

jamal: +1 on using the bot if we want a draft auto-created. but still need a human to sign/tag. i'll do the human bits.

sophia: merged #1234 — changelog is final. thanks for the patience. :tada:﻿

andrew: awesome. jamal — assigning tag + draft to you. carol — assigning artifacts + checksums to you. sophia — thanks for the changelog. I'll draft the short rollback blurb and verify the release notes before publish.

jamal: got it, i'll post back here with the tag sha and the draft link when done.

carol: will aim to finish uploads by 17:55 PT. ping me in this thread if anything blocks.

andrew: perfect. if anything unexpected happens, fallback plan is to push the tag as unsigned and follow up with signed annotated tag within 24h, but call it out in the release notes. :thumbsup:

jamal: noted. thanks all — will update here. :shipit:
